desc: Autosave in the Pit of 100 Trials (#71): its floors are the same few maps over and over (jon_00 for floor after floor), so autosave, which looked at the map's name alone, never saw a change and never saved there. A finished file's card (the full run's ending checkpoint as file 1), warped onto the Pit's first floor by its pipe (dokan_2) with Autosave on (every room); floor 1's enemy fought (the auto-battler with god mode), Mario down the risen pipe to floor 2 (jon_00 again): there the file is saved, on floor 2 (GSW_JON_FLOOR 1), and the card written. Nothing is saved on floor 1 (the warp isn't a room change) nor at the battle's end. autosave_pit_load loads this card back
log_must: \[input\] frame \d+: fight enemy: beaten after \d+ frames
^\[autosave\] file 1 saved in jon_00, Pit floor 2$
log_must_not: \[autosave\] file \d saved in jon_00, Pit floor 1$
